card.name: Scattered points inside drug-label sentences
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on varied spots in drug-label text, such as mL after a number, partway through drug names, or a period ending a sentence on drug interactions.

modes.label: Unit after a number
modes.description: The unit mL in a renal-function dose range.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Partway through a drug name, often after 'and' in a combination product.
modes.example: glyburide and<< met>>formin hydrochloride tablets therapy.

modes.label: Sentence-ending period
modes.description: A period ending a sentence about drug interactions, before advice on avoiding use.
modes.example: which may reduce RETEVMO anti-tumor activity<<.>> Avoid concomitant use of PPI

card.plain: It fires on a mix of unrelated spots in drug-label text, with no single pattern.
